long_biography.plain_text:
Greece's professional maritime-tourism owners association represents businesses operating crewed and bare-boat fleets. Panagiotis Nikolaos Lemos now acts as its secretary general after earlier service as a board member, giving him an enduring role in the organisation's direction.

Its agenda ranges from the chartering framework and the prevention of unlicensed operations to marina infrastructure, berth capacity, cleanliness and service standards. Lemos works within that practical mix of regulation, tourism and maritime enterprise. The post places him in an organisation whose members collectively cover thousands of crewed and bare-boat vessels serving the Greek market.
